messages:
Anita Patel: Heads up — I'm taking over primary for the evening. Primary->Secondary swap in 10m. quick check: any known gaps before handoff?
Carlos Mendez: thx Anita. no active pagers right now, but noticed elevated p99 on eu-west last hour. trace looks like KV cache misses + pod churn.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT (P2) — backend.kv-cache.euw increased error rate 12:36 UTC · Pager routed to @Carlos Mendez · runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback
Maya Li: re: p99 — I ran a quick tail on logs, saw repeated 502 from model-proxy (replica flapping). Possibly bad rollout.
Carlos Mendez: correct — there was a canary deploy ~2h ago that hit 10% traffic, but autoscale didn't stabilize. I'm going to mark canary paused and scale up the stable pool.
Anita Patel: good. leave canary paused and shift traffic to stable region for customer-facing routes. We should document for the handoff who did which steps.
DevOps Lead: noted. remediation checklist for handoff: 1) pause canary (kubectl patch ...) 2) scale stable pool + add warm replicas 3) flush prefix cache for impacted model 4) route EU traffic to us-east fallback if latency > 800ms for 5m
Carlos Mendez: commands: ```bash
# pause canary
kubectl -n inference patch deployment model-canary -p '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'
# scale stable
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-stable --replicas=6
# clear prefix cache (careful: bursts)
redis-cli -h kv-cache.euw.redis.delprefix model:v1:prefix
```
Maya Li: also add: check GPU driver logs on the flapping nodes: /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and dmesg for OOMs. I've added the logs link: https://logs.redwood/internal/hosts/euw/model-proxy
Anita Patel: for handoff notes — if scaling doesn't remove errors within 15m, fallback plan B is to route nonessential internal traffic to a lower-cost quantized variant and set alerts to page SRE if errors persist.
Carlos Mendez: pinging @Maya Li to confirm when stable pool hits steady p95 < 400ms. I'll update the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback#evening-fallbacks
Maya Li: confirmed — scaled to 6, two nodes showing 'CrashLoopBackOff' still. I'm draining those and moving traffic off.
Anita Patel: okay, I'm leaving these handoff notes in the rotation doc. Primary tonight: Anita, Secondary: Carlos. On-call reminders: - escalate to DevOps Lead after 30m unresolved - page ENG-SRE if customer impact > 5% of requests - use /incident create if incident rising to P1.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded — primary: Anita Patel, secondary: Carlos Mendez, started 4998412345.
DevOps Lead: added quick links to the handoff thread: runbooks, rollback checklist, escalation policy: https://redwood.internal/links/oncall-evening-pack
Anita Patel: thanks team. I'll monitor for the next 45m, annotate the ticket with steps taken. If anything spikes, call bridge. :phone: :thumbsup:
